agentGuide: Base path /api/v3. Series: GET /api/v3/series (id, title, monitored, statistics); one: GET /api/v3/series/<id>; episodes: GET /api/v3/episode?seriesId=<id>; missing: GET /api/v3/wanted/missing?pageSize=20. Find a show: GET /api/v3/series/lookup?term=<title>; add it: POST /api/v3/series with the lookup object plus qualityProfileId, rootFolderPath, monitored: true, addOptions: {"searchForMissingEpisodes": true}. Commands: SeriesSearch (seriesId), EpisodeSearch (episodeIds), RefreshSeries, RssSync. Queue: GET /api/v3/queue; history: GET /api/v3/history?pageSize=20; calendar: GET /api/v3/calendar?start=YYYY-MM-DD&end=YYYY-MM-DD; health and version: GET /api/v3/health, /api/v3/system/status. Profiles and folders before adding: GET /api/v3/qualityprofile, /api/v3/rootfolder. Searches and refreshes are commands: POST /api/v3/command {"name": "..."}. Never send the key, it is set automatically.
